court_datum_basis: Estimated paved floor: approximately1m clean open landward approach plus0.3m raised stone paving. It is not a surveyed historic absolute elevation; do not infer ground from the keep DSM perimeter median5.812m.
barracks_height_basis: Estimated two-level casemate range, matching EAO1984 photograph on PDFpage30; no published numeric casemate height.
outer_wall_height_basis: MWNF publishes2m width and8m height. Top uses7.4m abovecourt plus1.1m merlons over lower coastal footing.

references.title: Alam Al Benaa48, August1984, EAO Archaeological Review
references.evidence: PDFpage27/printed6 maps court, inner barracks, north casemates and keep; PDFpage30/printed9 documents courtyard-level keep entrance and two-storey casemates; PDFpage35 English synopsis reports17m tower and landscaped court.

references.title: Tarek Torky, Citadel of Qaytbay, Museum With No Frontiers
references.evidence: Keep30m square and17m tall, three storeys; outerwalls2mwide8mhigh;5–10m passages between walls.

approach_start_basis: Open approach sample east=-110m,north=-100m has ground0.975m. The walkway endpoint one metre farther south uses1.02m including paving, an interpolation estimate.
